title: Unit Event — Stick to Your Faith — Episode4 The Right Choice

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need are gearing up to make their professional debut. As their label considers how best to market the band, Mr. Shindo asks the girls what music they aspire to.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C's Voice
rows.Line:
Right...
But she promised ages ago that she'd come. Shouldn't this party take priority?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But if it didn't sound like she was gonna budge...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (But if I had, I wouldn't have finished my assignment...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Dad...
Are you coming back from work?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yeah. I was just having a meeting with this band I've been looking after. They have a show coming up.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Are you on your way home from school, Shiho? It's pretty late...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I was busy doing calligraphy today.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we were assigned to draw characters for class. The due date was today, so I had to stay back and finish mine.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
I see...
So, did yours turn out the way you wanted?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: What I turned in was probably the best one I've ever drawn...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: But you don't seem all that happy...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: It's okay. You can tell me what's wrong...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll feel a lot better after you get it off your chest.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I was actually supposed to go to a classmate's birthday party today... But I decided not to go because I wanted to keep working on my calligraphy...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: And my decision ended up hurting them.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I know I would've regretted turning in something I wasn't happy with.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: But I also never meant to upset everyone...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I'm wondering if I should've gone to that party after all...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I see. That's a tough pickle...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Still, after deciding to stay back, you ended up producing your best piece of calligraphy today, right?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I think you should be proud of that.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Yes.
However, I also understand your predicament...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Getting to do what you want is important, but so is understanding how others feel.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Ideally, I would've been able to work faster and still make it to the birthday party, but...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Shiho, why don't we go see another show together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
A show?
Sure, but where'd that come from...?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: There's a group of ladies that I want you to meet.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Hearing their music might give you a hint as to how you should make those kinds of decisions going forward.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'm at a live house again...
But it's never not exciting to be at one.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (It being kinda dark is a part of it... But there's more to it than just that...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (The sounds you sometimes hear when they're tuning and testing the instruments. The way you can sorta barely see what's going on. All of that...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I dunno why, but it always gets me really excited...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Wait, we're going backstage...?
Am I allowed?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Yeah, I already got permission.
It's okay as long as you don't get in the way of the staff...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(This is what it looks like backstage...?
I had no idea...)
Oh, Mr. Hinomori, you made it!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I thought this was my chance to say hi. You don't go on for a little while, right?

rows.Speaker: Girl Band Member A
rows.Line:
Wow, thank you so much!
Sumire's gonna be so stoked!

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Shiho, this is the leader of Iolite.
They're the band I said I've been looking after, remember...?

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line:
Everyone, listen! Big news!
Mr. Hinomori brought over this really adorable girl to meet us! Apparently she's his daughter, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member B
rows.Line:
Oh, hey, look at that.
How old are you, sweetie?

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line: Ten?! Wow, you're so calm and collected though.

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member B
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mr. Hinomori, she looks just like you. I dunno if it's her eyes, but she looks like she means business just like her daddy. I bet she'll grow up to have a really cool look.

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member C
rows.Line: You think so? But she's so soft and cuddly. Just feel her cheeks. She's gonna turn out such a cutie.

rows.Speaker: Iolite Member A
rows.Line:
Either way, she's a gorgeous girl!
I can't get enough of her.
Oh, geez. What are you guys up to now?

Give her some space, will you?
Imagine having a bunch of strangers gang up on you like that. Wouldn't you feel terrified?

Sorry about that.
They don't mean you any harm...

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm Sumire Kuno.
It's great to meet you. I'm the bassist for this band.
